_notes.source_aliases: Reward lists whose EDID names no quest the exports can be joined to — companion outro lists carry the ALLY's name, not the quest's. Keyed on the EDID with the list-type tokens (LL/LLI/LLS) already stripped; matched longest key first.
_notes.excluded: Page items that are mod records rather than weapons. Bethesda's own WeaponsUniqueNamedList has never heard of these.

excluded.Incendiary: a legendary effect name, not an item — its only effect text comes from a zzz_ cut record
excluded.Overkill: mod_Custom_Overkill, a Fat Man mod record
excluded.Storm Cutter: mod_melee_StormCutter — the V63 Zweihaender's own unique mod
excluded.Meadow Breeze Sprayer Bounty: the bounty-variant copy of the Abraxo Gun's mod record
